title: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:
summary: Doubt is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
lifeApplication: Return to one clear line before reopening every question at once. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.

source.lifeApplication: Doubt becomes more truthful when siree Raag, Third Mehla:.

evidence.turn: Doubt steadies when they alone see the Lord, unto whom He reveals Himself. O Nanak, the Gurmukhs.
evidence.practicalImplication: Return to one clear line before reopening every question at once. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.
